trimmedBy: node trim-ats-b-captures.mjs (JSON.parse, whole-record selection by record predicate (the two smallest offers and the one fixed-term offer), regex redaction of e-mail addresses and separator-bearing phone numbers inside string values, JSON.stringify, prettier); never a byte cut
notes: bunq: 21 offers captured (620,703 bytes; all published, all hybrid), 3 kept whole. Every offer carries company_name "bunq", which is the ownership evidence (EVIDENCE: PAYLOAD_FIELD). careers_url is on the employer's own domain (careers.bunq.com/o/{slug}), not on recruitee.com, so the canonical posting URL must be taken from the data. mailbox_email (a per-offer job.<code> mailbox on bunq.recruitee.com) is an address and was replaced. ENDPOINT: Careers Site API, https://{company}.recruitee.com/api/offers/ (docs.recruitee.com/reference/offers: the operation declares "security": [], query parameters department and tag, no pagination, no terms of use). TOKEN, checked 2026-10-24: docs.recruitee.com/reference/authentication-1 says a Careers Site API client "needs to authenticate first with a header" X-Careers-Sites-Token, that the token covers /offers, /offers/:id and /offers/:offer_slug/candidates, that "Deadline for introducing the token to calls is 10 February 2027" and that "Calls without the authorization header will return the 401 Unauthorized error". The token is generated by a USER OF THE EMPLOYER'S OWN Recruitee account ("Careers API token only covers single account's Careers Site API"), so a third party can never hold one: from 2027-02-10 this source is KEY_REQUIRED for every tenant and the adapter refuses to run (it never sends the header). Before that date the endpoint answers WITHOUT the header, measured on three tenants the same day (bunq 200, tellent 200, an unknown tenant 404). robots.txt: tellent.recruitee.com answers "User-Agent: * / Disallow: /v/" (so /api/offers/ is allowed); bunq.recruitee.com/robots.txt redirects to the employer's own domain (careers.bunq.com/robots.txt: "User-agent: * / Allow: /"); api.recruitee.com (the authenticated ATS API, a different host) is "Disallow: /" and is not used. E-mail addresses and phone numbers inside string values were replaced by a parser; personal NAMES in free-text descriptions cannot be found by a parser and were not redacted.
